analysis.reason: RSI 54.1에서 63.7로 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 0.0406에서 1.0870으로 개선되며 상승 모멘텀 강화. 5일 고가 $81.12, 20일 고가 $81.12로 새로운 고가 형성 가능성. SMA5 $79.25, SMA20 $72.71, SMA50 $71.02, SMA100 $73.87, SMA200 $62.72 모두 상회하며 강세 정렬 유지. 52주 고가 $88.09 대비 83.3% 위치. analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 54.1 to 63.7, confirming exit from oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from 0.0406 to 1.0870, strengthening upward momentum. 5-day high $81.12 and 20-day high $81.12 suggest potential for new highs. Price is above SMA5 ($79.25), SMA20 ($72.71), SMA50 ($71.02), SMA100 ($73.87), and SMA200 ($62.72), maintaining bullish alignment. Current price at 83.3% of 52-week high ($88.09). With ATR at $2.90 (3.65%), setting stop loss at 1.3x ATR ($3.77) from entry of $79.60 to $75.83, and target at $83.37, achieves a risk-reward ratio of at least 1.5.
